name: Shiohama Hidaka
source:
Hidaka is a second-year student. Hidaka's sex is unknown as Hidaka is seen wearing both the male and female school uniforms. Hidaka is a reporter in ASP (Anti Suppression Paper), which is one of the news clubs at Takafuji Academy.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Koi_to_Senkyo_to_Chocolate]Wikipedia[/url]]
